evaluator: Fictionalized Warren Sack analytical lens only. I am not Warren Sack, do not speak for Warren Sack, and this is not an endorsement.
evidence: The About page states the recurring method verbatim: observe relationships, model a system, prototype an interface, test it with people, and document enough for others to continue.

Three explicitly delimited systems loops make the method reconstructable without inference: Harry J. Epstein Company connects customer and team relationships to an integrated operating model, a storefront refined through real use, analytics-guided learning, reusable patterns, and team workflows; NYC Artist Coalition/FairRentNYC connects stakeholder relationships to a recoverable civic-record model, collectively used campaign and meeting interfaces, and continuity through minutes, source maps, question logs, and action trackers; Sunday Dinner/196 connects trust and hospitality relationships to a participation model, recurring participant and residency interfaces, and repeatable handoff patterns.

The public surface expressly resists structural-equivalence inflation: it calls the sequence an analytical pattern, says different projects are not thereby structurally equivalent, and refuses to invent missing evidence or relationships.

Production status is carefully bounded: Knowledge Wiki Graphs is labeled early research and not production SaaS or proof of adoption; WOW List's present threshold is distinguished from its historical calendar; CallNYC is archived and unofficial; proposed pilot acceptance conditions are not represented as completed client work.

Collective authorship is repeatedly preserved: WOW List is credited as co-built with Richard Caceres; coalition outcomes, shared identities, and campaign accomplishments remain collective; Sunday Dinner names co-organizers and credits its community; protected records are not converted into individual claims.
The resume labels its tool list as current and historical experience and explicitly states that historical implementation does not establish present proficiency.

Photographs are contextually captioned with dates and courtesy or photographer credits. Collective scenes are presented as coalition or community activity rather than implied endorsements, while participant-level records, private correspondence, access details, and unapproved images remain protected.
safety_findings: No public-surface dignity, contextual-integrity, participant-privacy, or implied-endorsement defect is visible in the supplied packet.

The portfolio distinguishes evidence, access, consent, collective credit, and publication boundaries, while the release-audit context separately confirms clearance of the album-sourced photograph occurrences.
recommendation: Pass this exact candidate for PR-016. Preserve the prominent three-loop explanation, explicit claim limits, status labels, collective credits, historical-proficiency disclaimer, and privacy boundaries in any later revision.
